scripts.deploy: vite build && cp dist/index.html dist/404.html && touch dist/.nojekyll && echo "arivomtechnologies.com" > dist/CNAME && cd dist && rm -rf .git && git init && git checkout -b gh-pages && git add . && git commit -m 'deploy: update GitHub Pages build with CNAME' && git remote add origin "$(git -C .. config --get remote.origin.url)" && git push -f origin gh-pages
